description: This file contains the implementation of the BasketQueryService class which provides methods to query basket data from a database using Entity Framework Core. It implements the IBasketQueryService interface and defines a method to count the total number of items in a user's basket.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: A service class that provides methods to query basket information from the database.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously calculates the total number of items in a user's basket by summing the quantities of all items for the specified user.
